newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Berjaya Group active ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group active ahead of results.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd topped the actives list on Thursday in the Singapore stock exchange with about 10 million shares traded on expectatations of good half year results, dealers said.
The group, which is involved in investment holding, provision of management services and trading, is expected to soon announce results for the six month period ended October 1996.
Berjaya was trading around Singapore $1.38 at 0350 GMT, up S$0.06. On the Kuala Lumpur exchange, the stock also topped the actives list, up 10 sen at 2.45 ringgit.
